name: context-lens-python
description: Generate and sandbox-verify Python unit tests via CodeLens, with RAG-retrieved codebase context and an AI code review of bugs/duplication after tests pass. Supports OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs.
author: Eyobel Gebre

contextLens.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint, an Anthropic API key (`sk-ant-...`), or a Google Gemini API key (`AIza...`). Falls back to the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, or `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable when left blank.

contextLens.apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Ignored when calling Anthropic or Gemini directly.

contextLens.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to verify generated tests.

contextLens.provider.description: Which API to call. 'auto' guesses from the API key format / base URL; set this explicitly if your key doesn't match the expected prefix.

contextLens.maxRetries.description: Maximum generate-and-verify attempts before giving up.

contextLens.temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent to the model for both test generation and analysis. Lower is more deterministic.

contextLens.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from the model per call. Increase for very large functions/classes.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:unit
